title: Letters and Vow
author: J. M. Fairweather
blurb: Sebastian Vasquez, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
